name: coding-narrator
description: Speak concise coding progress with local or natural voices and personal speaking skills.

interface.shortDescription: Hear coding progress in your style
interface.longDescription: Opt-in spoken progress with an animated mini dock, Windows voices, optional natural AI voices, and personal speaking skills. Supports local MCP clients including Claude Code. Natural voice requires server-side API access. Narration history is not saved.
defaultPrompt: Use Coding Narrator to narrate progress while you work on this task.
